items.title: 美國為何突然出手救日元？貝森特最怕亞洲貨幣競貶
items.title_en: Why Is the United States Suddenly Acting to Save the Yen? Bessent’s Biggest Fear Is an Asian Currency Devaluation Race
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 周二 (4 日) 表示，美國之所以罕見加入日本的買進日元行動，是因為日元持續疲弱可能迫使其他亞洲國家競相讓本幣貶值，進而動搖區域及全球金融市場。
貝森特接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」訪問時表示，穩定的日元不僅對美國重要，對整個亞洲也相當關鍵。他指出，日元若大幅貶值，可能對其他國家形成貨幣貶值壓力，目前韓元已出現劇烈波動，人民幣匯率也存在遭到低估的疑慮。
貝森特表示，考量日本的貿易規模、經濟體量，以及日本對全球儲蓄市場的貢獻，維持日元穩定至關重要。日本政府了解這一點，美方也樂於支持日本落實相關政策，共同協助穩定亞洲市場。
此次行動是美國罕見出手支撐另一種主要貨幣，凸顯華府擔心日元長期疲弱不僅會推高日本進口成本與通膨，也可能壓迫其他亞洲貨幣，甚至將金融動盪擴散至全球市場。
在這次美日聯合干預中，美國財政部動用外匯存底出售歐元，再將所得資金用於買進日元。貝森特表示，他已向歐洲官員保證，出售歐元只是美國外匯存底的重新配置，並非刻意打壓歐元。
貝森特指出，美日是在日元遭到「嚴重低估」後，聯手進場買進日元。兩國政府此前一直保持密切聯繫，華府也相信日本將採取適當政策，使日元逐步回到較為正常的水準。
不過，貝森特坦言，干預只能在短期內抑制匯市波動，無法單獨決定日元的長期走勢。他強調，政府可以透過干預向市場發出訊號，但真正扭轉匯率方向的仍是政策。
貝森特拒絕直接評論日本央行是否應該升息，僅表示日本官員必須在干預後推出更廣泛的政策，處理造成日元走弱的根本因素。美國決定參與此次行動，正是因為對日本接下來的政策路線抱持樂觀態度。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday (the 4th) that the United States’ rare decision to join Japan in buying yen is driven by the concern that a persistently weak yen could force other Asian countries to competitively devalue their own currencies, thereby destabilising regional and global financial markets.

In an interview on CNBC’s “Squawk Box,” Bessent stressed that a stable yen is not only important for the United States but also crucial for the entire Asian region. He warned that a sharp depreciation of the yen could create downward pressure on other currencies – the Korean won is already showing extreme volatility, and there are doubts that the renminbi is being undervalued.

Bessent noted that, given Japan’s trade size, economic weight and its contribution to the global savings market, keeping the yen stable is essential. The Japanese government understands this, and the U.S. is happy to support Japan in implementing related policies to help stabilise Asian markets jointly.

This intervention marks a rare instance of the United States backing another major currency, highlighting Washington’s worry that prolonged yen weakness would not only raise Japan’s import costs and inflation but also pressure other Asian currencies and potentially spread financial turbulence worldwide.

In the joint U.S.-Japan intervention, the Treasury used foreign‑exchange reserves to sell euros and then used the proceeds to buy yen. Bessent said he has assured European officials that the euro sales are merely a reallocation of U.S. reserves, not an intentional move to suppress the euro.

Bessent explained that the U.S. and Japan entered the market after the yen was deemed “severely undervalued.” The two governments have been in close contact, and Washington believes Japan will adopt appropriate policies to gradually bring the yen back to a more normal level.

However, Bessent admitted that intervention can only curb short‑term FX volatility and cannot determine the yen’s long‑term trajectory on its own. He emphasized that while governments can signal intentions through intervention, the real driver of exchange‑rate direction remains policy.

Bessent declined to comment directly on whether the Bank of Japan should raise rates, saying only that Japanese officials need to follow the intervention with broader measures that address the underlying factors behind the yen’s weakness. The United States chose to participate because it is optimistic about Japan’s forthcoming policy path.

items.title: 325億美元天價集體訴訟！iPhone相冊遭控違反隱私法律  650萬伊利諾用戶每人最高領5000
items.title_en: $32.5 Billion Record-High Class Action! iPhone Photo Album Accused of Violating Privacy Laws; Up to $5,000 per Eligible Illinois User Among 6.5 Million
paras: 美國第七巡迴上訴法院近日駁回蘋果緊急上訴，確認針對 iPhone「照片」應用程式人物相冊掃描人臉的集體訴訟成立，案件打回伊利諾州地院續審。
若原告最終舉證成功，按該州《生物識別資訊隱私法》(BIPA) 故意違規每人 5000 美元上限計算，650 萬名符合資格伊利諾州用戶最高可索賠 325 億美元，恐將成為美國科技業史上最大隱私類集體訴訟之一。
訴訟源於 2020 年 3 月，約 10 名伊利諾州用戶控告蘋果在無明確告知與書面同意下，於本機掃描照片生成面部特徵向量，並經 iCloud 同步雲端，違反 BIPA「採集前須告知用途、取得書面同意」硬性規定。
蘋果則抗辯稱相冊用的是不可逆特徵向量、不還原人臉、不綁身分，不構成法定生物識別標識，但伊利諾州地院 6 月認證集體訴訟、巡迴法院也在 6 月 30 日以「技術抽象化不豁免法律審查」為由駁回蘋果上訴。
BIPA 過失違規每次罰 1000 美元、故意或惡意 5000 美元，臉書曾以 6.5 億美元了結類似標籤案，Instagram 相關訴訟亦以 6850 萬美元和解，使 BIPA 成為生物數據訴訟核心武器。
目前，原告仍須在庭審證明蘋果確有未告知採集、雲端留存等行為，賠償金額非自動落槌，但集體訴訟門檻跨過後，蘋果面臨的已經不只是賠錢風險，而是全球 App 隱私授權邊界被重新畫線，設備端 AI 功能今後得把「掃臉建模」單獨寫進同意書。
paras_en: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit recently rejected Apple’s emergency appeal, confirming that the class action alleging the iPhone “Photos” app’s People album scans faces is viable, and sent the case back to the Illinois state court for further proceedings.

If the plaintiffs ultimately succeed in proving their case, the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA) allows damages of up to $5,000 per person for intentional violations, meaning up to 6.5 million qualifying Illinois users could seek as much as $32.5 billion in compensation—potentially one of the largest privacy class actions in U.S. tech history.

The lawsuit stems from March 2020, when about ten Illinois users sued Apple for scanning photos on the device to generate facial feature vectors without clear notice or written consent, and then syncing those vectors to iCloud, which they say violates BIPA’s strict requirement to disclose the purpose of collection and obtain written consent beforehand.

Apple argued that the album uses irreversible feature vectors that do not reconstruct faces or link to identities, and therefore does not constitute a biometric identifier under the law. However, the Illinois state court certified the class action in June, and the appellate court also denied Apple’s appeal on June 30, stating that “technical abstraction does not shield a practice from legal scrutiny.”

Under BIPA, negligent violations incur a $1,000 penalty per instance, while intentional or reckless violations incur $5,000 per instance. Facebook previously settled a similar case for $650 million, and an Instagram‑related suit was resolved for $68.5 million, making BIPA a central weapon in biometric data litigation.

The plaintiffs still must prove at trial that Apple indeed collected facial data without notice and stored it in the cloud; damages are not automatic. Yet once the class‑action threshold is crossed, Apple faces more than just a financial risk—it could reshape global app‑privacy consent boundaries, forcing AI features on devices to explicitly list “face‑modeling” in user agreements.

items.title: 〈台幣〉出口商+央行救場 量縮貶幅收斂險守32.5元大關
items.title_en: Exporters and Central Bank Bailout Narrow TWD Depreciation, Guarding the 32.5‑Per‑Dollar Barrier
paras: 台股今 (4) 日走勢震盪小跌作收，新台幣兌美元盤中再度面臨 32.5 元關卡保衛戰，但央行持續介入穩匯，加上出口商擴大拋匯，帶動匯價拉升至平盤附近，以 32.447 元作收，微貶 0.9 分，為連 2 貶，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值萎縮至 24.7 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤報 32.447 元，午後在外資擴大匯出下，匯價一度下探至 32.495 元，距 32.5 元大關僅一步之遙。隨著匯價來到相對低點，出口商隨即進場擴大拋匯，台幣貶幅縮小；加上央行尾盤適時調節，終場幾乎回吐午後所有貶幅，收在 32.447 元。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.19%，日元歷經昨日的飆漲後，今天回跌 0.65%，韓元貶值 0.33%，星幣貶值 0.12%，新台幣小貶 0.03%，人民幣則小升 0.03%，主要亞幣偏貶。
美股昨日強勢大漲，但台股今日開盤後一度下跌近 500 點，台積電領跌，電子權值股漲跌互見，不過，矽光子、PCB、記憶體等族群獲得資金青睞，大盤跌幅收斂，終場收在 43360.66 點，跌 25.75 點。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market edged lower in a volatile session today, while the New Taiwan dollar (NTD) faced another test at the 32.5 per USD level. The central bank’s continued intervention helped stabilize the exchange rate, and exporters’ increased foreign‑currency sales pushed the rate back toward the flat‑rate area, closing at 32.447 NTD per USD, a modest 0.9‑point decline and the second consecutive drop. The total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets shrank to US$2.47 billion.

The NTD opened at 32.447 per USD. In the afternoon, foreign investors expanded their currency outflows, briefly driving the rate to 32.495, just a hair away from the 32.5 threshold. As the rate hit this relative low, exporters stepped in with larger currency sales, narrowing the depreciation. Coupled with timely adjustments by the central bank near the close, the market almost fully recovered the afternoon’s losses, ending again at 32.447.

Looking at major currencies against the dollar, central‑bank data show the US Dollar Index rose 0.19%. The Japanese yen, after yesterday’s surge, fell 0.65% today. The Korean won slipped 0.33%, the Singapore dollar 0.12%, the New Taiwan dollar a modest 0.03% decline, while the Chinese yuan edged up 0.03%, indicating a general weakening of Asian currencies.

U.S. equities rallied strongly yesterday, but Taiwan’s market fell nearly 500 points after the open, led down by TSMC. Electronics heavyweights showed mixed moves, while sectors such as silicon photonics, printed circuit boards and memory chips attracted buying. The overall market’s decline narrowed, closing at 43,360.66 points, down 25.75 points.

items.title: 〈財報〉AI資料中心需求點火！開拓重工上季業績超預期、上調全年財測
items.title_en: Caterpillar's AI Data Center Demand Ignites Quarterly Earnings Beat
paras: 有「景氣金絲雀」之稱的開拓重工 (Caterpillar) 周二 (4 日) 美股盤前公布 2026 會計年度第二季 (截至 6/30) 財報，受惠人工智慧 (AI) 資料中心建設帶動發電設備與工程機械需求，營收與獲利雙雙超越華爾街預期，單季營收更首度突破 200 億美元。公司同步上調全年營收成長展望並下修關稅成本預估，激勵股價盤前飆逾 10%。
截稿前，開拓重工 (CAT-US) 周二盤前股價上漲 10.48%，每股暫報 917 美元。
開拓重工第二季營收年增 24% 至 205.4 億美元，高於市場預期的約 193 億美元；淨利由去年同期的 21.8 億美元增至 35.9 億美元，每股盈餘由 4.62 美元升至 7.77 美元。排除一次性項目後，調整後每股盈餘達 8.17 美元，不僅高於去年同期的 4.72 美元，也大幅超越分析師預估的 6.17 至 6.22 美元。
執行長 Joe Creed 表示，這是公司史上首度單季營收突破 200 億美元，強勁接單與持續增加的積壓訂單，顯示旗下三大核心業務動能全面擴大。
隨著全美加速興建 AI 資料中心，市場對施工機具、柴油發電機及工業燃氣渦輪等設備的需求大增。開拓重工第二季新增訂單達 94 億美元，推升積壓訂單至創紀錄的 721 億美元。
其中，營建事業營收年增 35% 至 83.5 億美元，北美市場更大增 50%；能源與運輸事業營收成長 17% 至 82.4 億美元，主要受到資料中心大型發電機組與渦輪需求帶動。兩大部門合計占公司總營收約 81%。資源事業營收則年增 20% 至 46.5 億美元。
能源與運輸部門近年已超越開拓重工最廣為人知的挖土機等工程機械業務，成為公司規模最大、成長最快的事業。投資人也因此將開拓重工與 Vertiv、GE Vernova 等電力設備業者一同納入 AI 概念股範疇。
展望全年，開拓重工預估營收將成長約 15% 至 19%，高於先前預測的低雙位數增幅。公司並將全年關稅成本預估，由原先的 22 億至 26 億美元下修至約 22 億美元，反映美國關稅下降，加上資料中心、基礎建設與能源專案支出持續擴張，進一步改善公司營運前景。
paras_en: Caterpillar, dubbed the 'economic canary,' reported second-quarter earnings that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven by the construction of artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, which boosted demand for power generation equipment and engineering machinery. The company's revenue and profit both surpassed expectations, with quarterly revenue exceeding $20 billion for the first time.
Caterpillar's (CAT-US) stock price rose 10.48% before the market opened on Tuesday, trading at $917 per share.

Caterpillar's second-quarter revenue grew 24% to $20.54 billion, surpassing market expectations of around $19.3 billion. Net income increased to $3.59 billion from $2.18 billion in the same period last year, with earnings per share rising to $7.77 from $4.62. Adjusted earnings per share reached $8.17, exceeding analysts' estimates of $6.17 to $6.22 and surpassing last year's $4.72.

CEO Joe Creed stated that this is the company's first time exceeding $20 billion in quarterly revenue, with strong order intake and increasing backlog orders demonstrating the expansion of its three core businesses.

As the US accelerates the construction of AI data centers, demand for construction equipment, diesel generators, and industrial gas turbines has increased significantly. Caterpillar's second-quarter new orders reached $9.4 billion, pushing its backlog to a record $72.1 billion.

The construction business saw revenue growth of 35% to $8.35 billion, with the North American market increasing by 50%. The energy and transportation business saw revenue growth of 17% to $8.24 billion, driven by the demand for large power generation sets and turbines for data centers.
The two business segments combined account for approximately 81% of the company's total revenue. The resource business saw revenue growth of 20% to $4.65 billion.

The energy and transportation segment has surpassed Caterpillar's most well-known construction equipment business, becoming the company's largest and fastest-growing business. Investors have therefore included Caterpillar in the AI concept stock category alongside Vertiv, GE Vernova, and other power equipment companies.

Looking ahead to the full year, Caterpillar expects revenue to grow by 15% to 19%, surpassing its previous prediction of low double-digit growth. The company has also lowered its full-year tariff cost estimate from $2.2 billion to $2.6 billion to around $2.2 billion, reflecting the decline in US tariffs and the continued expansion of data center, infrastructure, and energy project spending, which further improves the company's operating outlook.

items.title: 金管會：國內VASP轉帳3萬元以上須提供生日、住所 10月起上路
items.title_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission: Domestic VASPs Must Provide Birthdate and Address for Transactions Over NT$300,000 Starting October
paras: 金管會今 (4) 日宣布，為落實洗錢防制與打擊資恐，並與國際標準接軌，將預告修正相關辦法。自今 (2026) 年 10 月起，國內虛擬資產服務提供者 (VASP) 在進行虛擬資產移轉時，必須執行「轉帳規則 (Travel Rule)」。若單筆移轉金額達新台幣 3 萬元以上，轉出方業者除傳遞基本交易資料外，還須額外提供客戶的出生日期與住所，以利接收方核對身份與降低犯罪風險。跨境移轉預計 2027 年底前實施。
證期局副局長黃仲豪指出，現行國內 8 家完成洗錢防制聲明或合規的 VASP 業者雖已進行各類虛擬資產移轉，但過去並未具備法定義務要求傳輸與保存特定客戶資料。本次修訂主要參照防制洗錢金融行動工作組織 (FATF) 建議的 1000 美元 (歐洲為 1000 歐元) 門檻，折合新台幣約為 3 萬元。
黃仲豪說明，開戶時的 KYC(認識客戶) 驗證與交易過程中的移轉確認是完全不同的概念，如同銀行開戶需確認身份，後續匯款仍要確認是否為本人及款項流向；在虛擬資產跨機構或跨境移轉時，接收方同樣需要知道前端轉出者的身份。
針對新規定，黃仲豪表示，VASP 不論移轉價值多寡，均應實施 Travel Rule，不過，移轉價值逾新台幣 3 萬元時，應依轉出人及接收人之身分屬自然人或法人，分別取得額外資訊 (如：轉出人為自然人者，應額外取得其出生日期及住所地地址；如為法人者，則應額外取得其官方辨識編號及設立登記地地址)，以強化交易可追溯性及洗錢防制監理措施。
VASP 於擔任虛擬資產移轉之接收方，且移轉價值逾新台幣 3 萬元時，應就轉出方所提供的接收人資訊，與其所持有的客戶資訊進行核對，以強化資訊正確性及風險控管機制。
不過，金管會採取分階段推動，今年 10 月起優先實施「國內 VASP 對國內 VASP」的移轉；至於「跨境移轉 (境外交易所對接)」則考量到各國法制進度與技術規格銜接難度，預計延長至 2027 年年底前實施。
外界關切業者是否會因系統對接或合規負擔增加作業成本，金管會表示，先前已與公會及業者進行充分溝通，目前國內業者已針對傳輸規格與系統 API 介面達成共識，技術面問題已克服，在執行上沒有問題。
此外，金管會強調，若業者未依規定將相關檢查流程納入內部控制制度，或未落實資料傳輸與核對，金融檢查時將視為內控缺失，並可依《洗錢防制法》相關規定開罰新台幣 50 萬元以上、1000 萬元以下罰緩。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) announced today that it will revise related regulations to implement the 'Travel Rule' for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) in Taiwan. Starting October 2026, domestic VASPs must execute the Travel Rule when conducting virtual asset transfers. If the single transaction amount exceeds NT$300,000, the sender must provide the recipient's birthdate and address in addition to basic transaction information to facilitate the recipient's verification of identity and reduce the risk of crime.

FSC Vice Commissioner Huang Zhonghao pointed out that the current 8 domestic VASPs that have completed anti-money laundering (AML) declarations or compliance have been conducting various types of virtual asset transfers, but have not had the legal obligation to transmit and store specific customer data in the past. This revision mainly refers to the 1000 USD (1,000 EUR) threshold recommended by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), equivalent to approximately NT$300,000.

Huang explained that the KYC (Know Your Customer) verification at the time of account opening and the transfer confirmation during the transaction process are two different concepts, just like how banks verify identities when opening accounts and then verify whether the account holder is the same person and the funds are flowing to the correct account. In the case of virtual asset cross-institution or cross-border transfers, the recipient also needs to know the identity of the sender.

Regarding the new regulations, Huang stated that VASPs should implement the Travel Rule regardless of the transaction value, but if the transaction value exceeds NT$300,000, they should obtain additional information from the sender and recipient, depending on whether they are natural persons or legal persons. For example, if the sender is a natural person, they should obtain their birthdate and address, while if they are a legal person, they should obtain their official identification number and registered address.

VASPs acting as the receiving party in virtual asset transfers and exceeding NT$300,000 in value should verify the information provided by the sender with their own customer information to enhance the accuracy of information and risk management mechanisms.

However, the FSC will implement the regulations in stages, with a priority on 'domestic VASP to domestic VASP' transfers starting in October, and 'cross-border transfers' (foreign exchanges connected to Taiwan) expected to be implemented by the end of 2027, taking into account the progress of laws and regulations in various countries and the difficulty of technical specifications.

Industry stakeholders have expressed concerns about whether the increased system integration and compliance burden will increase operational costs. The FSC has stated that it has had sufficient communication with industry associations and operators, and that domestic operators have reached a consensus on transmission specifications and system API interfaces, and have overcome technical issues, making it possible to implement the regulations without problems.

The FSC also emphasized that if operators fail to incorporate related inspection procedures into their internal control systems or fail to implement data transmission and verification, they will be considered internal control deficiencies and may be fined NT$500,000 to NT$10 million under the Anti-Money Laundering Act.

items.title: 美伊協議傳接近達成、企業財報報喜！道瓊期貨勁揚600點
items.title_en: US-Iran Deal Nears Completion, Boosting Earnings Reports! Dow Futures Surge 600 Points
paras: 美股主要指數期貨周二 (4 日) 走高，開拓重工 (Caterpillar)(CAT-US) 與 Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US)財報優於預期，加上美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 透露，美國與伊朗可能很快就重新開放荷姆茲海峽達成協議，帶動國際油價重挫，道瓊期貨一度大漲 600 點。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數期貨上漲 600 點或 1.1%，主要受到開拓重工盤前大漲 9% 帶動；標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.3%，那斯達克 100 指數期貨勁揚 1.1%。Palantir 財報報喜，激勵股價盤前飆升逾 15%，美光 (MU-US) 上漲 4%，邁威爾科技 (MRVL-US) 勁揚 8%。
貝森特接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」訪問時表示，美方正在與伊朗談判，雙方可能在周二或周三達成協議，重新開放荷姆茲海峽、恢復商船自由通行，並推動衝突回歸較為正常的局面。
相關說法緩解市場對原油供應中斷的擔憂，西德州中級原油期貨下跌 4%，來到每桶約 77 美元；國際基準布蘭特原油期貨下挫 3%，報每桶約 80 美元。
美股周一已全面走強，道瓊指數收盤創下歷史新高。亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 市值首度突破 3 兆美元，輝達 (NVDA-US)、Meta(META-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 與微軟 (MSFT-US) 同步上漲。經過周一漲勢後，標普 500 指數距離盤中歷史高點僅差 0.27%，周二有望進一步刷新紀錄。
企業財報方面，開拓重工第二季營收與獲利雙雙超越預期，並上調全年營收成長展望，同時預估關稅成本將落在原先預測區間低端。Palantir 第二季業績同樣大幅優於預期，執行長 Alex Karp 更以「超凡脫俗」形容財報表現，商業部門營收激增 149% 至 7.64 億美元。
Interactive Brokers 資深經濟學家 Jose Torres 表示，製造業與服務業最新數據，加上近期企業財報電話會議，提振市場對企業回饋股東能力的信心，尤其科技股經歷大幅拋售後，估值已明顯降低。
投資人周二也將關注 6 月工廠訂單與國際貿易數據，以及 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 上市後首份季度財報。SpaceX 股價在開盤前上漲 2%。
paras_en: US stock market futures rose sharply on Tuesday (4th) as Caterpillar (CAT-US) and Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US) reported better-than-expected earnings, and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent revealed that the US and Iran may soon reach a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, leading to a sharp decline in international oil prices, with Dow futures surging 600 points.

As of the cut-off time, Dow Industrial Index futures rose 600 points or 1.1%, mainly driven by Caterpillar's pre-market surge of 9%; S&P 500 Index futures rose 0.3%, and Nasdaq 100 Index futures surged 1.1%. Palantir's earnings report was a pleasant surprise, driving its stock price to soar over 15% pre-market; Micron (MU-US) rose 4%, and Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) surged 8%.

Bessent, in an interview with CNBC's 'Squawk Box', stated that the US is in talks with Iran, and the two sides may reach a deal by Tuesday or Wednesday to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, restore commercial shipping freedom, and push the conflict back to a more normal state.

The related statement eased market concerns about oil supply disruptions, with West Texas Intermediate crude futures falling 4% to around $77 per barrel; International benchmark Brent crude futures dropped 3% to around $80 per barrel.

The US stock market had a strong rally on Monday, with the Dow Index closing at a new historical high. Amazon (AMZN-US) broke through the $3 trillion valuation mark for the first time, while NVIDIA (NVDA-US), Meta (META-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US), and Microsoft (MSFT-US) all rose in sync. Following Monday's surge, the S&P 500 Index is just 0.27% away from its intraday historical high, and is expected to break the record on Tuesday.

In terms of corporate earnings, Caterpillar reported second-quarter revenue and profit that exceeded expectations, and raised its full-year revenue growth outlook, while also estimating that tariff costs will fall within the previously predicted range. Palantir's second-quarter results were also significantly better than expected, with CEO Alex Karp describing the earnings report as 'exceptional', with commercial segment revenue surging 149% to $764 million.

Interactive Brokers' senior economist Jose Torres stated that the latest manufacturing and service industry data, combined with recent corporate earnings conference calls, have boosted market confidence in companies' ability to return value to shareholders, particularly in the tech sector, which has experienced significant selling pressure and has seen its valuation decline significantly.

Investors will also focus on June factory orders and international trade data on Tuesday, as well as SpaceX's (SPCX-US) first quarterly earnings report after its IPO. SpaceX's stock price rose 2% pre-market.

items.title: 油價警報要解除了？貝森特：美伊最快兩天內重開荷姆茲海峽
items.title_en: Oil Price Warning Lifted? Bessent: US-Iran to Reopen Hormuz Strait in 2 Days
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 周二 (4 日) 表示，美國與伊朗最快可能在周二或周三 (5 日) 達成協議，重新開放荷姆茲海峽，確保商船自由通行，並推動美伊衝突逐步回歸較為正常的局面。
貝森特接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」訪問時表示，美方目前正與伊朗進行談判，雙方有機會在今天或明天就重開荷姆茲海峽達成協議。
被問及協議是否可能允許伊朗向通過海峽的船隻收取通行費時，貝森特表示，協議應會保障「自由通行」，但並未透露具體內容，暗示美方不接受伊朗以收費方式控制這條關鍵航道。
貝森特坦言，荷姆茲海峽過去幾天的安全情勢仍有些不穩定，但目前已觀察到不少船隻陸續駛出。他估計，目前有數百艘、甚至多達 1000 艘船隻受困海峽內，等待恢復通行，運載貨物不只有能源，還包括肥料、精煉油品及各類工業氣體。
貝森特預期，一旦荷姆茲海峽重新開放，相關商品價格將進一步下跌，市場可能出現一波強勁的紓壓行情。荷姆茲海峽是全球能源與商品運輸要道，若航運恢復正常，將有助降低供應中斷風險，緩解國際油市對短缺的擔憂。
消息傳出後，國際油價應聲走跌，10 月交割的布蘭特原油期貨一度下跌近 4%，盤中下挫 2.32% 至每桶 81.83 美元；9 月交割的西德州原油期貨下跌 2.97%，至每桶 77.95 美元。
美國總統川普上周末表示，為替重開荷姆茲海峽的談判創造空間，他已取消一項針對伊朗的大規模攻擊計畫。不過，美伊上月原本也曾擬定重開海峽的諒解備忘錄，最終仍宣告破局，此後雙方不時互相發動軍事攻擊，海峽航運也持續受限。
川普先前曾多次宣稱解決衝突的協議即將達成，但美伊戰火隨後又再度升高。因此，儘管貝森特最新說法帶動油價大跌，市場仍將密切觀察雙方能否把談判進展轉化為正式協議。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday (4th) that the US and Iran may reach an agreement as early as Tuesday or Wednesday (5th) to reopen the Hormuz Strait, ensuring the free passage of commercial ships and pushing the US-Iran conflict back to a more normal state.

Bessent, in an interview with CNBC's 'Squawk Box', said that the US is currently negotiating with Iran, and there is a possibility that an agreement to reopen the Hormuz Strait could be reached as early as today or tomorrow.

When asked if the agreement would allow Iran to charge tolls to ships passing through the strait, Bessent said that the agreement would ensure 'free passage', but did not reveal any details, implying that the US does not accept Iran's control of the critical waterway through tolls.

Bessent acknowledged that the security situation in the Hormuz Strait has been unstable over the past few days, but noted that many ships have been seen leaving the area. He estimated that there are hundreds, or even up to 1,000, ships stranded in the strait, waiting for the passage to be reopened, carrying goods including energy, fertilizers, refined oil products, and various industrial gases.

Bessent expects that once the Hormuz Strait is reopened, related commodity prices will continue to fall, and the market may see a strong relief rally. The Hormuz Strait is a critical waterway for global energy and commodity transportation, and normalizing shipping would help reduce the risk of supply disruptions and alleviate concerns about oil shortages.

After the news broke, international oil prices plummeted, with Brent crude futures for October delivery falling nearly 4% and trading at $81.83 per barrel, down 2.32% from the previous day; West Texas Intermediate crude futures for September delivery fell 2.97% to $77.95 per barrel.

US President Trump said last weekend that he had canceled a major attack plan against Iran to create space for negotiations to reopen the Hormuz Strait. However, the US and Iran had previously agreed to a draft agreement to reopen the strait in August, but ultimately failed to reach an agreement, leading to ongoing military attacks and limited shipping in the area.

Trump had previously claimed that a deal to resolve the conflict was imminent, but the fighting between the two countries escalated again. Despite Bessent's latest comments, which led to a sharp decline in oil prices, the market will closely watch whether the negotiations can be turned into a formal agreement.

items.title: 凌華接單穩定、漲價效應 估下半年營收雙位數年增 毛利率可望回升
items.title_en: Ling Hwa Sees Stable Orders, Price Hike Effect Boosts Revenue Growth
paras: 工業電腦廠凌華 (6166-TW) 今 (4) 日召開法說，總經理黃怡暾表示，上半年接單出貨比 (BB Ratio) 達 1.5，下半年接單動能保持穩定，加上漲價效益帶動，營收可望雙位數年增，毛利率也可望回升。
黃怡暾表示，上半年美國表現強勁，包括大型 ODM、醫療、博弈，以及新興的機器人專案正在慢慢發生，各方面都在成長；歐洲醫療專案也做得不錯，軌道交通也有一些需求，國防方面也有一些短期跟急單需求浮現。
亞太方面，黃怡暾表示，主要動能為半導體設備跟供應鏈需求，除了新加坡、台灣、韓國、日本等，下半年也看到中國半導體快速成長，此外，中國在新能源也有一些相關的專案訂單將慢慢放量。
黃怡暾表示，上半年 BB Ratio 達 1.5，目前看起來下半年接單動能可望延續，中長期希望能維持在 1.2-1.3，並持續看好邊緣 AI 應用從較成熟的自駕車、安控等，擴大到醫療、機器人、交通、半導體、自動化及新能源等應用。
針對零組件成本上漲，黃怡暾表示，第二季起陸續向客戶轉嫁成本，多數客戶已逐漸接受，但零售業與政府標案客戶因預算固定較難轉嫁，目前客戶對於調漲 10% 尚能接受，但若到 20%，客戶也會很痛苦，就必須進行協商。
零組件料況來看，黃怡暾認為，雖然 CPU/GPU 交期較長，但公司跟 Intel、NVIDIA 等主要供應商維持長期合作關係、供應穩定，記憶體則採用分散多家供應鏈的策略以確保貨源，PCB 的高階玻纖布供應較為吃緊，會是個挑戰。
paras_en: Ling Hwa (6166-TW) held a conference call today, with CEO Huang Yi-chun stating that the company's order fulfillment ratio (BB Ratio) reached 1.5 in the first half of the year. With stable order momentum expected in the second half, combined with the price hike effect, revenue growth is expected to be in the double digits, and gross margin is expected to rebound.

Huang Yi-chun noted that the US market performed strongly in the first half, including large ODM, medical, gaming, and emerging robotics projects. European medical projects also performed well, with some demand for rail transportation and defense projects.

In the Asia-Pacific region, Huang Yi-chun stated that the main drivers are semiconductor equipment and supply chain demand, with Singapore, Taiwan, South Korea, Japan, and China all experiencing growth. China's semiconductor industry is expected to grow rapidly in the second half, and there are also some related new energy projects in China.

Huang Yi-chun stated that the BB Ratio reached 1.5 in the first half, and it appears that order momentum will continue in the second half. In the medium to long term, the company hopes to maintain a BB Ratio of 1.2-1.3, and is optimistic about the expansion of edge AI applications from autonomous driving, security, and other areas to medical, robotics, transportation, semiconductors, automation, and new energy.

Regarding the increase in component costs, Huang Yi-chun stated that the company has been gradually passing on the costs to customers since the second quarter. Most customers have accepted the price hike, but retail and government customers with fixed budgets have been more difficult to pass on the costs. Customers can accept a 10% price hike, but a 20% hike will be painful, and the company will need to negotiate.

In terms of component availability, Huang Yi-chun believes that while CPU/GPU lead times are long, the company has maintained long-term partnerships with major suppliers such as Intel and NVIDIA, ensuring stable supply. Memory is sourced from multiple suppliers to ensure a stable supply, but high-end PCBs with fiber optic substrates are in short supply and will be a challenge.

items.title: 〈台幣〉出口商+央行救場 量縮貶幅收斂險守32.5元大關
items.title_en: Exporters and Central Bank Bailout Narrow TWD Depreciation, Guarding the 32.5‑Per‑Dollar Barrier
paras: 台股今 (4) 日走勢震盪小跌作收，新台幣兌美元盤中再度面臨 32.5 元關卡保衛戰，但央行持續介入穩匯，加上出口商擴大拋匯，帶動匯價拉升至平盤附近，以 32.447 元作收，微貶 0.9 分，為連 2 貶，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值萎縮至 24.7 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤報 32.447 元，午後在外資擴大匯出下，匯價一度下探至 32.495 元，距 32.5 元大關僅一步之遙。隨著匯價來到相對低點，出口商隨即進場擴大拋匯，台幣貶幅縮小；加上央行尾盤適時調節，終場幾乎回吐午後所有貶幅，收在 32.447 元。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.19%，日元歷經昨日的飆漲後，今天回跌 0.65%，韓元貶值 0.33%，星幣貶值 0.12%，新台幣小貶 0.03%，人民幣則小升 0.03%，主要亞幣偏貶。
美股昨日強勢大漲，但台股今日開盤後一度下跌近 500 點，台積電領跌，電子權值股漲跌互見，不過，矽光子、PCB、記憶體等族群獲得資金青睞，大盤跌幅收斂，終場收在 43360.66 點，跌 25.75 點。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market edged lower in a volatile session today, while the New Taiwan dollar (NTD) faced another test at the 32.5 per USD level. The central bank’s continued intervention helped stabilize the exchange rate, and exporters’ increased foreign‑currency sales pushed the rate back toward the flat‑rate area, closing at 32.447 NTD per USD, a modest 0.9‑point decline and the second consecutive drop. The total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets shrank to US$2.47 billion.

The NTD opened at 32.447 per USD. In the afternoon, foreign investors expanded their currency outflows, briefly driving the rate to 32.495, just a hair away from the 32.5 threshold. As the rate hit this relative low, exporters stepped in with larger currency sales, narrowing the depreciation. Coupled with timely adjustments by the central bank near the close, the market almost fully recovered the afternoon’s losses, ending again at 32.447.

Looking at major currencies against the dollar, central‑bank data show the US Dollar Index rose 0.19%. The Japanese yen, after yesterday’s surge, fell 0.65% today. The Korean won slipped 0.33%, the Singapore dollar 0.12%, the New Taiwan dollar a modest 0.03% decline, while the Chinese yuan edged up 0.03%, indicating a general weakening of Asian currencies.

U.S. equities rallied strongly yesterday, but Taiwan’s market fell nearly 500 points after the open, led down by TSMC. Electronics heavyweights showed mixed moves, while sectors such as silicon photonics, printed circuit boards and memory chips attracted buying. The overall market’s decline narrowed, closing at 43,360.66 points, down 25.75 points.

items.title: 金管會：國內VASP轉帳3萬元以上須提供生日、住所 10月起上路
items.title_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission: Domestic VASPs Must Provide Birthdate and Address for Transactions Over NT$300,000 Starting October
paras: 金管會今 (4) 日宣布，為落實洗錢防制與打擊資恐，並與國際標準接軌，將預告修正相關辦法。自今 (2026) 年 10 月起，國內虛擬資產服務提供者 (VASP) 在進行虛擬資產移轉時，必須執行「轉帳規則 (Travel Rule)」。若單筆移轉金額達新台幣 3 萬元以上，轉出方業者除傳遞基本交易資料外，還須額外提供客戶的出生日期與住所，以利接收方核對身份與降低犯罪風險。跨境移轉預計 2027 年底前實施。
證期局副局長黃仲豪指出，現行國內 8 家完成洗錢防制聲明或合規的 VASP 業者雖已進行各類虛擬資產移轉，但過去並未具備法定義務要求傳輸與保存特定客戶資料。本次修訂主要參照防制洗錢金融行動工作組織 (FATF) 建議的 1000 美元 (歐洲為 1000 歐元) 門檻，折合新台幣約為 3 萬元。
黃仲豪說明，開戶時的 KYC(認識客戶) 驗證與交易過程中的移轉確認是完全不同的概念，如同銀行開戶需確認身份，後續匯款仍要確認是否為本人及款項流向；在虛擬資產跨機構或跨境移轉時，接收方同樣需要知道前端轉出者的身份。
針對新規定，黃仲豪表示，VASP 不論移轉價值多寡，均應實施 Travel Rule，不過，移轉價值逾新台幣 3 萬元時，應依轉出人及接收人之身分屬自然人或法人，分別取得額外資訊 (如：轉出人為自然人者，應額外取得其出生日期及住所地地址；如為法人者，則應額外取得其官方辨識編號及設立登記地地址)，以強化交易可追溯性及洗錢防制監理措施。
VASP 於擔任虛擬資產移轉之接收方，且移轉價值逾新台幣 3 萬元時，應就轉出方所提供的接收人資訊，與其所持有的客戶資訊進行核對，以強化資訊正確性及風險控管機制。
不過，金管會採取分階段推動，今年 10 月起優先實施「國內 VASP 對國內 VASP」的移轉；至於「跨境移轉 (境外交易所對接)」則考量到各國法制進度與技術規格銜接難度，預計延長至 2027 年年底前實施。
外界關切業者是否會因系統對接或合規負擔增加作業成本，金管會表示，先前已與公會及業者進行充分溝通，目前國內業者已針對傳輸規格與系統 API 介面達成共識，技術面問題已克服，在執行上沒有問題。
此外，金管會強調，若業者未依規定將相關檢查流程納入內部控制制度，或未落實資料傳輸與核對，金融檢查時將視為內控缺失，並可依《洗錢防制法》相關規定開罰新台幣 50 萬元以上、1000 萬元以下罰緩。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) announced today that it will revise related regulations to implement the 'Travel Rule' for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) in Taiwan. Starting October 2026, domestic VASPs must execute the Travel Rule when conducting virtual asset transfers. If the single transaction amount exceeds NT$300,000, the sender must provide the recipient's birthdate and address in addition to basic transaction information to facilitate the recipient's verification of identity and reduce the risk of crime.

FSC Vice Commissioner Huang Zhonghao pointed out that the current 8 domestic VASPs that have completed anti-money laundering (AML) declarations or compliance have been conducting various types of virtual asset transfers, but have not had the legal obligation to transmit and store specific customer data in the past. This revision mainly refers to the 1000 USD (1,000 EUR) threshold recommended by the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), equivalent to approximately NT$300,000.

Huang explained that the KYC (Know Your Customer) verification at the time of account opening and the transfer confirmation during the transaction process are two different concepts, just like how banks verify identities when opening accounts and then verify whether the account holder is the same person and the funds are flowing to the correct account. In the case of virtual asset cross-institution or cross-border transfers, the recipient also needs to know the identity of the sender.

Regarding the new regulations, Huang stated that VASPs should implement the Travel Rule regardless of the transaction value, but if the transaction value exceeds NT$300,000, they should obtain additional information from the sender and recipient, depending on whether they are natural persons or legal persons. For example, if the sender is a natural person, they should obtain their birthdate and address, while if they are a legal person, they should obtain their official identification number and registered address.

VASPs acting as the receiving party in virtual asset transfers and exceeding NT$300,000 in value should verify the information provided by the sender with their own customer information to enhance the accuracy of information and risk management mechanisms.

However, the FSC will implement the regulations in stages, with a priority on 'domestic VASP to domestic VASP' transfers starting in October, and 'cross-border transfers' (foreign exchanges connected to Taiwan) expected to be implemented by the end of 2027, taking into account the progress of laws and regulations in various countries and the difficulty of technical specifications.

Industry stakeholders have expressed concerns about whether the increased system integration and compliance burden will increase operational costs. The FSC has stated that it has had sufficient communication with industry associations and operators, and that domestic operators have reached a consensus on transmission specifications and system API interfaces, and have overcome technical issues, making it possible to implement the regulations without problems.

The FSC also emphasized that if operators fail to incorporate related inspection procedures into their internal control systems or fail to implement data transmission and verification, they will be considered internal control deficiencies and may be fined NT$500,000 to NT$10 million under the Anti-Money Laundering Act.

items.title: 凌華接單穩定、漲價效應 估下半年營收雙位數年增 毛利率可望回升
items.title_en: Ling Hwa Sees Stable Orders, Price Hike Effect Boosts Revenue Growth
paras: 工業電腦廠凌華 (6166-TW) 今 (4) 日召開法說，總經理黃怡暾表示，上半年接單出貨比 (BB Ratio) 達 1.5，下半年接單動能保持穩定，加上漲價效益帶動，營收可望雙位數年增，毛利率也可望回升。
黃怡暾表示，上半年美國表現強勁，包括大型 ODM、醫療、博弈，以及新興的機器人專案正在慢慢發生，各方面都在成長；歐洲醫療專案也做得不錯，軌道交通也有一些需求，國防方面也有一些短期跟急單需求浮現。
亞太方面，黃怡暾表示，主要動能為半導體設備跟供應鏈需求，除了新加坡、台灣、韓國、日本等，下半年也看到中國半導體快速成長，此外，中國在新能源也有一些相關的專案訂單將慢慢放量。
黃怡暾表示，上半年 BB Ratio 達 1.5，目前看起來下半年接單動能可望延續，中長期希望能維持在 1.2-1.3，並持續看好邊緣 AI 應用從較成熟的自駕車、安控等，擴大到醫療、機器人、交通、半導體、自動化及新能源等應用。
針對零組件成本上漲，黃怡暾表示，第二季起陸續向客戶轉嫁成本，多數客戶已逐漸接受，但零售業與政府標案客戶因預算固定較難轉嫁，目前客戶對於調漲 10% 尚能接受，但若到 20%，客戶也會很痛苦，就必須進行協商。
零組件料況來看，黃怡暾認為，雖然 CPU/GPU 交期較長，但公司跟 Intel、NVIDIA 等主要供應商維持長期合作關係、供應穩定，記憶體則採用分散多家供應鏈的策略以確保貨源，PCB 的高階玻纖布供應較為吃緊，會是個挑戰。
paras_en: Ling Hwa (6166-TW) held a conference call today, with CEO Huang Yi-chun stating that the company's order fulfillment ratio (BB Ratio) reached 1.5 in the first half of the year. With stable order momentum expected in the second half, combined with the price hike effect, revenue growth is expected to be in the double digits, and gross margin is expected to rebound.

Huang Yi-chun noted that the US market performed strongly in the first half, including large ODM, medical, gaming, and emerging robotics projects. European medical projects also performed well, with some demand for rail transportation and defense projects.

In the Asia-Pacific region, Huang Yi-chun stated that the main drivers are semiconductor equipment and supply chain demand, with Singapore, Taiwan, South Korea, Japan, and China all experiencing growth. China's semiconductor industry is expected to grow rapidly in the second half, and there are also some related new energy projects in China.

Huang Yi-chun stated that the BB Ratio reached 1.5 in the first half, and it appears that order momentum will continue in the second half. In the medium to long term, the company hopes to maintain a BB Ratio of 1.2-1.3, and is optimistic about the expansion of edge AI applications from autonomous driving, security, and other areas to medical, robotics, transportation, semiconductors, automation, and new energy.

Regarding the increase in component costs, Huang Yi-chun stated that the company has been gradually passing on the costs to customers since the second quarter. Most customers have accepted the price hike, but retail and government customers with fixed budgets have been more difficult to pass on the costs. Customers can accept a 10% price hike, but a 20% hike will be painful, and the company will need to negotiate.

In terms of component availability, Huang Yi-chun believes that while CPU/GPU lead times are long, the company has maintained long-term partnerships with major suppliers such as Intel and NVIDIA, ensuring stable supply. Memory is sourced from multiple suppliers to ensure a stable supply, but high-end PCBs with fiber optic substrates are in short supply and will be a challenge.

items.title: 會計業搶食碳商機！PwC資誠普華綠色科技獲產品碳足跡查驗資格
items.title_en: Accounting Firms Seize Carbon Opportunities! PwC's Green Technology Unit Gains Product Carbon Footprint Verification Qualification
paras: 產品碳足跡盤查已成為全球減碳與供應鏈管理的重要關鍵。PwC 資誠普華綠色科技公司 7 月 30 日正式取得環境部認可之產品碳足跡（查驗類別 P）合格查驗機構資格，成為四大會計師事務所中首家獲此資格者。未來將提供符合 ISO 14067 及相關規範之產品碳足跡查驗服務，協助企業掌握產品生命週期之溫室氣體排放資訊，並便利企業申請環境部碳標籤，攜手應對國際碳關稅與供應鏈減碳挑戰，穩健推進低碳轉型。
在國際碳關稅與供應鏈減碳要求的雙重壓力下，企業對於符合國際標準及主管機關規範之產品碳足跡查驗需求持續飆升。環境部近年來持續推動產品碳足跡制度發展，鼓勵企業透過產品碳足跡盤查與查驗，掌握產品生命週期各階段之溫室氣體排放資訊，進而作為產品減碳、供應鏈管理及永續資訊揭露的重要依據。
資誠普華綠色科技公司總經理李宗哲表示，隨著企業面臨來自供應鏈、客戶及投資人的減碳要求持續增加，建立可信賴且透明的產品碳資訊，已成為企業永續管理的核心課題。資誠普華綠色科技公司長期投入溫室氣體第三方查驗業務，熟悉國際標準及國內相關法規要求，並具備服務多元產業客戶的豐富實務經驗。

李宗哲指出，繼去年取得環境部組織型溫室氣體合格查驗機構資格後，今年再度取得產品碳足跡合格查驗機構資格，未來將持續秉持獨立、公正及專業精神，提供高品質的查驗服務。資誠普華綠色科技公司結合 PwC Taiwan 的專業資源與產業經驗，為企業提供從組織層級到產品層級的完整查驗服務鏈；PwC Taiwan 專業團隊可支援企業掌握產品碳排資訊、強化供應鏈溝通基礎，並因應日益提升的減碳與揭露要求，全面搶攻綠色轉型商機。
paras_en: Product carbon‑footprint accounting has become a key pillar of global decarbonisation and supply‑chain management. On July 30, PwC’s Green Technology unit (PwC Taiwan) officially received qualification from Taiwan’s Ministry of Environment as an approved verification body for product carbon footprints (Verification Category P), becoming the first of the Big‑Four accounting firms to earn this status. Going forward it will offer verification services that meet ISO 14067 and related standards, helping companies capture greenhouse‑gas emissions across a product’s life cycle, facilitating applications for the Ministry’s carbon‑label scheme, and jointly tackling international carbon‑tariff and supply‑chain decarbonisation challenges to advance a steady low‑carbon transition.

Amid the twin pressures of international carbon‑tariff rules and supply‑chain emission targets, demand for product‑level carbon‑footprint verification that complies with global standards and regulator requirements is soaring. In recent years the Ministry of Environment has been actively promoting the product carbon‑footprint system, encouraging firms to conduct footprint inventories and verifications so they can understand emissions at every stage of a product’s life cycle and use that data as a basis for product decarbonisation, supply‑chain management and sustainability disclosures.

Lee Tzung‑che, General Manager of PwC’s Green Technology unit, said that as companies face growing decarbonisation demands from supply chains, customers and investors, establishing trustworthy and transparent product carbon data has become a core sustainability issue. The unit has long been involved in third‑party greenhouse‑gas verification, is well‑versed in international standards and domestic regulations, and has rich practical experience serving clients across diverse industries.

Lee noted that after obtaining qualification as an organisational‑level greenhouse‑gas verification body from the Ministry last year, the firm has now secured product‑carbon‑footprint verification status as well. It will continue to uphold independence, impartiality and professionalism to deliver high‑quality verification services. By combining PwC Taiwan’s professional resources and industry expertise, the Green Technology unit offers a full verification service chain from organisational to product level; PwC Taiwan’s team can help firms capture product carbon‑emission data, strengthen supply‑chain communication, and meet the rising decarbonisation and disclosure requirements, fully capitalising on green‑transition business opportunities.

items.title: 進泰電子Q2轉盈EPS爲0.19 元 下半年營運拚成長
items.title_en: Jin Tai Electronics Turns Profitable in Q2 2026 with EPS of NT$0.19, Aims for Growth in H2
paras: 音訊產品供應商進泰電子 (3465-TW) 已發行現增股自市場籌資 2.1 億元，進泰電子並於 (4) 日公布最新獲利資訊，2026 年第二季稅後純益 656 萬元，較上季及去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.19 元，上半年稅後虧損 2588 萬元，每股虧損 0.73 元。
音訊產品製造商進泰電子 2026 年第二季營收 6.17 億元，毛利率 15.8%，季增 9.88 個百分點，年減 7.03 個百分點，2026 年第二季稅後純益 656 萬元，較上季及去年同期轉盈，每股純益 0.19 元。
進泰電子 2026 年 1-6 月營收 9.54 億元，毛利率 12.31%，年減 9.21 個百分點，上半年稅後虧損 2588 萬元，每股虧損 0.73 元。
進泰電子第二季營收回溫，主要受惠美系客戶拉貨動能提升、音響新機開發專案陸續收成，以及客戶旗艦機種陸續放量挹注；同時，進泰電子現金增資募得資金 2.1 億元，將於明 (5) 日上櫃交易，資金將全數用於償還銀行借款，有利於財務結構的改善。
進泰電子對 2026 年下半年營運的展望，公司認為，隨著產品價格調漲確定、關鍵零組缺貨及產能瓶頸情況已獲得改善，產品結構優化調整，且進泰電子另一新系列音響產品即將邁入量產階段，加上影音擴大機 AVR 產品將於下半年量產出貨，均有助於下半年營運表現，法人預估進泰電子 2026 年營運仍將逐季攀高、下半年營運表現將明顯優於上半年表現。
paras_en: Audio product supplier Jin Tai Electronics (3465-TW) has issued new shares to raise NT$210 million from the market, and on the 4th announced its latest profit figures: a Q2 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$6.56 million, turning to profit versus both the previous quarter and the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$0.19. In the first half of the year the company posted an after‑tax loss of NT$25.88 million, or a loss per share of NT$0.73.

Audio product manufacturer Jin Tai Electronics reported Q2 2026 revenue of NT$617 million, a gross margin of 15.8%, up 9.88 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but down 7.03 percentage points year‑over‑year, and an after‑tax net profit of NT$6.56 million, turning to profit versus both the previous quarter and the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$0.19.

Jin Tai Electronics' revenue for the January‑June 2026 period was NT$954 million, with a gross margin of 12.31%, down 9.21 percentage points year‑over‑year, and an after‑tax loss of NT$25.88 million for the first half, or a loss per share of NT$0.73.

The Q2 revenue rebound was driven mainly by stronger pull‑through from U.S. customers, the gradual completion of new audio‑equipment development projects, and increasing shipments of flagship models from key customers. At the same time, the NT$210 million raised through the cash‑increase will be listed on the over‑the‑counter market on May 5 and will be used entirely to repay bank loans, improving the company’s financial structure.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Jin Tai Electronics expects that confirmed product price hikes, the easing of component shortages and capacity bottlenecks, and an optimized product mix—along with a new series of audio products entering mass production and the AVR (audio‑video receiver) line beginning volume shipments in H2—will boost performance. Analysts forecast that the company’s operating results will continue to rise quarter‑by‑quarter, with H2 performance markedly better than the first half.

items.title: 賴清德授勳 麥考爾透露：川普很快將提送國會140億美元關鍵軍售案
items.title_en: Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen Awards Honorary Title to US Rep. Michael McCaul
paras: 總統賴清德今 (4) 日頒授美國聯邦眾議院外交委員會榮譽主席麥考爾 (Michael McCaul)「大綬景星勳章」，表彰其長年深化台美關係、維護台海和平穩定所做的卓越貢獻。麥考爾則表示，去 (2025) 年 12 月，美國國會批准了史上最大金額、價值 110 億美元的對外軍售，他有信心，美國總統川普很快將向國會提出另一項軍售案，提供價值 140 億美元的關鍵軍事防衛裝備。
賴清德表示，這枚勳章承載著台灣人民最誠摯的敬意，也象徵台美之間深厚的情誼。台灣堅守民主防線，也深信和平靠實力，實力必須建立在堅定的自我防衛決心之上，他特別感謝麥考爾長期支持臺灣提升國防力量，除了敦促美國行政部門加速交付對台軍售武器裝備，今 (2026) 年也與美國國會跨黨派議員一起支持台灣推動國防特別預算。這些具體行動充分展現美國國會對台灣安全的堅定承諾，
賴清德指出，台灣會持續推動國防改革、強化不對稱戰力、建立無人機攻防體系，並提升全社會防衛韌性，期待與美國深化合作，從軍事採購進一步走向共同研發、共同生產，攜手維護印太地區和平與穩定。
賴清德也提到，台美夥伴關係也正向經貿及科技領域加速拓展，麥考爾代表的德州，是美國重要的能源與科技產業重鎮，去年台灣是德州第七大出口市場，台灣與德州的經貿交流及產業合作，也已成為台美關係持續深化的重要力量，台灣希望持續增進與美國的關係，以更堅定的力量守護和平，以更緊密的合作創造繁榮。
麥考爾則重申，美國國會在 1979 年制定的《台灣關係法》至今依然堅實存在，是雙邊關係的根本基礎，美國必須提供臺灣防衛性武器，美國也正實踐這項承諾，美國政策絕不允許因為美中外交關係而影響對台軍售。
麥考爾也分享近期前往烏克蘭戰區，觀察到無人機科技及生產能力，相信這是對於台灣未來的存亡至關重要，並鼓勵台灣與其他已成功創新，能應對現代戰爭挑戰的民主國家合作。
麥考爾也恭喜台灣通過「國防特別預算」，強調應持續強化臺灣的防衛能力及韌性，其中包括和飛彈、無人機同等重要的網路安全。他有信心，川普總統很快將向國會提出另一項軍售案，提供追加價值 140 億美元的軍事防衛裝備。
paras_en: Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen awarded US Rep. Michael McCaul the Grand Cordon of the Order of Brilliant Star today (4), in recognition of his long-standing efforts to deepen Taiwan-US relations and maintain peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait.
McCaul expressed confidence that US President Donald Trump will soon submit a new arms sales package to Congress, worth $14 billion, to provide critical military defense equipment.

Tsai Ing-wen stated that the award represents the sincerest respect and gratitude of the Taiwanese people, symbolizing the deep friendship between Taiwan and the US. Taiwan will continue to uphold its democratic defense line and believe that peace relies on strength, which must be built on a firm commitment to self-defense.

Tsai Ing-wen thanked McCaul for his long-term support for Taiwan's defense capabilities and expressed appreciation for his efforts to urge the US administration to accelerate the delivery of military equipment to Taiwan. She also praised McCaul for his bipartisan support for Taiwan's defense special budget this year.

Tsai Ing-wen emphasized that Taiwan will continue to push for defense reform, strengthen asymmetric warfare capabilities, establish a drone defense system, and enhance societal defense resilience. She hopes to deepen cooperation with the US, moving from military procurement to joint research and development, and joint production, to jointly maintain peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific region.

Tsai Ing-wen also mentioned that the Taiwan-US partnership is accelerating its expansion into the trade and technology sectors. McCaul represents Texas, a key energy and technology hub in the US, and Taiwan is the seventh-largest export market for Texas.
Tsai Ing-wen stated that Taiwan hopes to continue to deepen its relationship with the US, with a stronger commitment to peace and a tighter cooperation to create prosperity.

McCaul reiterated that the Taiwan Relations Act, established by the US Congress in 1979, remains a fundamental basis for bilateral relations. He emphasized that the US must provide Taiwan with defensive weapons, and the US is committed to fulfilling this promise, without allowing the US-China diplomatic relationship to impact arms sales to Taiwan.

McCaul shared his recent visit to the Ukraine war zone, where he observed the development of drone technology and production capabilities, which he believes are crucial for Taiwan's survival. He encouraged Taiwan to cooperate with other democratic countries that have successfully innovated and can address modern warfare challenges.

McCaul congratulated Taiwan on passing the defense special budget and emphasized the need to continue strengthening Taiwan's defense capabilities and resilience, including network security, which is as important as missiles and drones. He expressed confidence that President Trump will soon submit a new arms sales package to Congress, worth an additional $14 billion in military defense equipment.

items.title: 〈緯創法說〉上半年EPS 7.78元 再斥資175億元同步投資台灣、美國與越南
items.title_en: Wistron Earnings Call: H1 EPS NT$7.78, Announces NT$17.5 billion Investment Across Taiwan, U.S. and Vietnam
paras: 緯創 (3231-TW) 今 (4) 日召開法說會並公告今年上半年財報，上半年營收 1.74 兆元，年增 94%，稅後純益 244.58 億元，每股純益 7.78 元，再寫新高。另外，緯創董事會也通過多項議案，對台灣、美國與越南擴大投資，總投資金額達 174.81 億元。
緯創第二季營收 8954.43 億元，季增 5.81%，年增 62.43%；毛利率 5.56%，季增 0.45 個百分點，年增 1.22 個百分點；營益率 3.74%，季增 0.29 個百分點，年增 1.78 個百分點；稅後純益 148.27 億元，季增 53.95%，年增 1.28 倍，每股純益 4.72 元。
緯創累計今年上半年營收 1.74 兆元，年增 94.01%；毛利率 5.44%，年減 0.3 個百分點；營益率 3.59%，年增 0.7 個百分點；稅後純益 244.58 億元，年增 1.07 倍，每股純益 7.78 元。
根據緯創公告，在台灣地區的投資上，擬新增新竹廠區與高雄廠區資本支出，分別增加 20 億元及 85 億元，主要用於取得機器設備，以因應未來產能擴充。
另外，為因應與日俱增的 AI 發展需求，緯創擬以 39.67 億元，在國立陽明交通大學台南校區緯創樓設立 AI 算力中心。此中心將支援緯創集團內部的 AI 運算需求，並透過捐贈運算資源，提供 AI 研究與教育計畫所需算力。
美國地區方面，緯創通過對 Wistron InfoComm (USA) Corporation 與 SMS Infocomm Corporation 兩家 100% 持股子公司，分別新增資本支出 2300 萬美元 (約新台幣 7.45 億元) 及 3000 萬美元 (約新台幣 9.72 億元)，因應未來 AI 相關業務發展。
至於越南地區，緯創擬增資 100% 持股的子公司 Wistron Property (Vietnam) Co., Ltd. 4000 萬美元 (約新台幣 12.96 億元)。
此外，緯創根據今年股東會授權，擬向主管機關提出必要申請，發行不超過 2.5 億股普通股，並以全球存托憑證 (GDRs) 形式發行。
整體而言，董事長林憲銘指出，緯創在未來幾年，將持續進行產能與提升競爭力的相關投資，並預期未來 1 至 2 年的資本支出將持續增加。他並指出，申請發行 GDRs，也是公司快速成長中的必要路徑。
paras_en: Wistron Corp. (3231‑TW) held an earnings conference today (April 4) and released its first‑half financial results. H1 revenue reached NT$1.74 trillion, up 94% year‑on‑year, with net profit after tax of NT$24.458 billion, translating to earnings per share of NT$7.78 – a new high. The board also approved several resolutions to expand investments in Taiwan, the United States and Vietnam, totaling NT$174.81 billion.

In Q2, Wistron posted revenue of NT$895.443 billion, a 5.81% quarterly increase and 62.43% year‑on‑year growth; gross margin was 5.56%, up 0.45 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 1.22 points year‑over‑year; operating margin was 3.74%, up 0.29 points QoQ and 1.78 points YoY; net profit after tax was NT$14.827 billion, up 53.95% QoQ and 1.28‑fold YoY, yielding EPS of NT$4.72.

For the first half of the year, Wistron’s cumulative revenue was NT$1.74 trillion, up 94.01% YoY; gross margin was 5.44%, down 0.3 percentage points YoY; operating margin was 3.59%, up 0.7 points YoY; net profit after tax was NT$24.458 billion, a 1.07‑times YoY increase, with EPS of NT$7.78.

According to the announcement, in Taiwan the company plans to add capital expenditures of NT$2 billion for a new plant in Hsinchu and NT$8.5 billion for an expansion at its Kaohsiung facility, mainly to acquire machinery and equipment for future capacity expansion.

To meet growing AI demand, Wistron will invest NT$3.967 billion (US$39.67 million) to establish an AI compute center in the Wistron Building on the Tainan campus of National Yang‑Ming Chiao‑Tung University. The center will support internal AI workloads and, through donated compute resources, provide AI research and education computing power.

In the United States, Wistron approved additional capital spending for its wholly‑owned subsidiaries Wistron InfoComm (USA) Corp. and SMS Infocomm Corp.: US$23 million (≈NT$7.45 billion) and US$30 million (≈NT$9.72 billion) respectively, to fund future AI‑related business development.
In Vietnam, Wistron intends to inject US$40 million (≈NT$12.96 billion) into its wholly‑owned subsidiary Wistron Property (Vietnam) Co., Ltd.

Furthermore, based on shareholder‑meeting authorisation, Wistron plans to apply to regulators for the issuance of up to 250 million ordinary shares, to be offered as Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs).

Chairman Lin Hsien‑ming said Wistron will continue investing in capacity and competitiveness over the coming years, expecting capital expenditures to keep rising over the next one to two years. He added that the GDR issuance is a necessary step for the company’s rapid growth.

items.title: 絕無蓋牌！金管會推官方台股儀表板 拚第3季底前上線
items.title_en: No Hidden Cards! Financial Supervisory Commission Pushes Official Taiwan Stock Dashboard, Aiming for Launch Before End of Q3
paras: 台股上月底劇烈修正，一度跌破 4 萬點大關，部分民間平台推估個股維持率引發斷頭恐慌，證交所多次澄清，現行制度是以整戶信用交易部位合併計算，並無單一個股低於 130% 即追繳的機制。金管會今 (4) 日亦強調「沒有蓋牌、只有亮牌」，已責成證交所整合大家最關心的數據，包含融資餘額、整戶擔保維持率等，規劃以「儀表板」方式呈現，預計於第 3 季底前推出，全面提升市場資訊透明度。
針對外界關切信用交易資訊與維持率等議題，證期局副局長黃仲豪指出，金管會對於資本市場的管理立場是「盡量提供正確、完整、即時的資訊給大眾參考」，秉持安全、透明、公平原則。包含信用交易融資餘額、整戶擔保維持率、借券賣出占比等重要數據，將會完整提供給投資人參閱，目前證交所正在研議，努力在今年第 3 季底前上線。
至於是否提供歷史數據回溯，黃仲豪說，將再與交易所評估資料完整性後研商。而民間機構如 CMoney 先前已經下架大盤融資維持率相關資訊，未來要如何發布運算數據，金管會予以尊重。
日前有媒體頻引用民間平台發布的「擔保維持率」，造成投資人誤以為特定個股低於 130% 即將面臨斷頭，證交所多次發布新聞稿澄清，指出現行制度絕不存在「單一個股擔保維持率低於 130% 即代表將遭追繳或斷頭」的機制。
依現行規定，信用交易擔保維持率是以投資人「整戶」部位作為管理基礎，採融資、融券合併計算，並涵蓋投資人持有的所有上市、上櫃信用交易部位及抵繳擔保品。券商辦理追繳或處分 (斷頭)，完全看「整戶維持率」是否達標，而非看單一個股。
民間平台因無法掌握投資人整戶的實際持股、融資券組合及其他抵繳擔保品等完整資訊，其推估之「個股維持率」無法反映真實信用風險。若投資人以此進行買賣決策，恐因誤判市場風險而增加自身損失，甚至造成個股價格不必要的過度波動。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks underwent a sharp correction at the end of last month, briefly falling below the 40,000-point mark. Some private platforms estimated individual stock maintenance ratios, sparking panic about margin calls. The Taiwan Stock Exchange repeatedly clarified that the current system calculates margin positions on a whole‑account basis, and there is no mechanism that triggers a call when a single stock falls below 130%. On the 4th, the Financial Supervisory Commission also emphasized "no hidden cards, only open cards" and tasked the exchange with integrating the data most investors care about—such as financing balances and whole‑account maintenance ratios—into a "dashboard" format, expected to be released before the end of the third quarter, thereby enhancing market information transparency.

Regarding public concerns about credit‑trading information and maintenance ratios, Deputy Director of the Securities and Futures Bureau Huang Zhong‑hao said the FSC’s stance on capital‑market oversight is to "provide the public with accurate, complete, and timely information" while upholding safety, transparency, and fairness. Important data—including credit‑trading financing balances, whole‑account maintenance ratios, and the proportion of securities borrowed for short selling—will be fully disclosed to investors. The exchange is currently studying the implementation and aims to go live before the end of Q3 this year.

As for whether historical data will be made available for back‑testing, Huang said this will be examined with the exchange after assessing data completeness. Private firms such as CMoney have already removed market‑wide financing‑maintenance‑ratio information; how they will publish calculated data in the future will be respected by the FSC.

Recently, media outlets repeatedly cited "maintenance ratios" released by private platforms, leading investors to mistakenly believe that a specific stock falling below 130% would face an imminent margin call. The exchange has issued multiple press releases to clarify that the current system does not contain any mechanism whereby a "single‑stock maintenance ratio below 130%" triggers a call or forced liquidation.

Under existing regulations, the credit‑trading maintenance ratio is based on the investor’s "whole‑account" position, combining financing and securities‑lending balances and covering all listed and over‑the‑counter credit‑trading positions as well as collateral. Brokers’ decisions to issue margin calls or enforce liquidations depend entirely on whether the whole‑account maintenance ratio meets the required level, not on any individual stock.

Because private platforms cannot access an investor’s complete holdings, financing‑securities portfolio, and other collateral, their estimated "stock‑specific maintenance ratios" do not reflect the true credit risk. If investors base trading decisions on these figures, they may misjudge market risk, increase their own losses, and even cause unnecessary price volatility in the affected stocks.

items.title: 325億美元天價集體訴訟！iPhone相冊遭控違反隱私法律  650萬伊利諾用戶每人最高領5000
items.title_en: $32.5 Billion Record-High Class Action! iPhone Photo Album Accused of Violating Privacy Laws; Up to $5,000 per Eligible Illinois User Among 6.5 Million
paras: 美國第七巡迴上訴法院近日駁回蘋果緊急上訴，確認針對 iPhone「照片」應用程式人物相冊掃描人臉的集體訴訟成立，案件打回伊利諾州地院續審。
若原告最終舉證成功，按該州《生物識別資訊隱私法》(BIPA) 故意違規每人 5000 美元上限計算，650 萬名符合資格伊利諾州用戶最高可索賠 325 億美元，恐將成為美國科技業史上最大隱私類集體訴訟之一。
訴訟源於 2020 年 3 月，約 10 名伊利諾州用戶控告蘋果在無明確告知與書面同意下，於本機掃描照片生成面部特徵向量，並經 iCloud 同步雲端，違反 BIPA「採集前須告知用途、取得書面同意」硬性規定。
蘋果則抗辯稱相冊用的是不可逆特徵向量、不還原人臉、不綁身分，不構成法定生物識別標識，但伊利諾州地院 6 月認證集體訴訟、巡迴法院也在 6 月 30 日以「技術抽象化不豁免法律審查」為由駁回蘋果上訴。
BIPA 過失違規每次罰 1000 美元、故意或惡意 5000 美元，臉書曾以 6.5 億美元了結類似標籤案，Instagram 相關訴訟亦以 6850 萬美元和解，使 BIPA 成為生物數據訴訟核心武器。
目前，原告仍須在庭審證明蘋果確有未告知採集、雲端留存等行為，賠償金額非自動落槌，但集體訴訟門檻跨過後，蘋果面臨的已經不只是賠錢風險，而是全球 App 隱私授權邊界被重新畫線，設備端 AI 功能今後得把「掃臉建模」單獨寫進同意書。
paras_en: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit recently rejected Apple’s emergency appeal, confirming that the class action alleging the iPhone “Photos” app’s People album scans faces is viable, and sent the case back to the Illinois state court for further proceedings.

If the plaintiffs ultimately succeed in proving their case, the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA) allows damages of up to $5,000 per person for intentional violations, meaning up to 6.5 million qualifying Illinois users could seek as much as $32.5 billion in compensation—potentially one of the largest privacy class actions in U.S. tech history.

The lawsuit stems from March 2020, when about ten Illinois users sued Apple for scanning photos on the device to generate facial feature vectors without clear notice or written consent, and then syncing those vectors to iCloud, which they say violates BIPA’s strict requirement to disclose the purpose of collection and obtain written consent beforehand.

Apple argued that the album uses irreversible feature vectors that do not reconstruct faces or link to identities, and therefore does not constitute a biometric identifier under the law. However, the Illinois state court certified the class action in June, and the appellate court also denied Apple’s appeal on June 30, stating that “technical abstraction does not shield a practice from legal scrutiny.”

Under BIPA, negligent violations incur a $1,000 penalty per instance, while intentional or reckless violations incur $5,000 per instance. Facebook previously settled a similar case for $650 million, and an Instagram‑related suit was resolved for $68.5 million, making BIPA a central weapon in biometric data litigation.

The plaintiffs still must prove at trial that Apple indeed collected facial data without notice and stored it in the cloud; damages are not automatic. Yet once the class‑action threshold is crossed, Apple faces more than just a financial risk—it could reshape global app‑privacy consent boundaries, forcing AI features on devices to explicitly list “face‑modeling” in user agreements.

items.title: 〈財報〉AI資料中心需求點火！開拓重工上季業績超預期、上調全年財測
items.title_en: Caterpillar's AI Data Center Demand Ignites Quarterly Earnings Beat
paras: 有「景氣金絲雀」之稱的開拓重工 (Caterpillar) 周二 (4 日) 美股盤前公布 2026 會計年度第二季 (截至 6/30) 財報，受惠人工智慧 (AI) 資料中心建設帶動發電設備與工程機械需求，營收與獲利雙雙超越華爾街預期，單季營收更首度突破 200 億美元。公司同步上調全年營收成長展望並下修關稅成本預估，激勵股價盤前飆逾 10%。
截稿前，開拓重工 (CAT-US) 周二盤前股價上漲 10.48%，每股暫報 917 美元。
開拓重工第二季營收年增 24% 至 205.4 億美元，高於市場預期的約 193 億美元；淨利由去年同期的 21.8 億美元增至 35.9 億美元，每股盈餘由 4.62 美元升至 7.77 美元。排除一次性項目後，調整後每股盈餘達 8.17 美元，不僅高於去年同期的 4.72 美元，也大幅超越分析師預估的 6.17 至 6.22 美元。
執行長 Joe Creed 表示，這是公司史上首度單季營收突破 200 億美元，強勁接單與持續增加的積壓訂單，顯示旗下三大核心業務動能全面擴大。
隨著全美加速興建 AI 資料中心，市場對施工機具、柴油發電機及工業燃氣渦輪等設備的需求大增。開拓重工第二季新增訂單達 94 億美元，推升積壓訂單至創紀錄的 721 億美元。
其中，營建事業營收年增 35% 至 83.5 億美元，北美市場更大增 50%；能源與運輸事業營收成長 17% 至 82.4 億美元，主要受到資料中心大型發電機組與渦輪需求帶動。兩大部門合計占公司總營收約 81%。資源事業營收則年增 20% 至 46.5 億美元。
能源與運輸部門近年已超越開拓重工最廣為人知的挖土機等工程機械業務，成為公司規模最大、成長最快的事業。投資人也因此將開拓重工與 Vertiv、GE Vernova 等電力設備業者一同納入 AI 概念股範疇。
展望全年，開拓重工預估營收將成長約 15% 至 19%，高於先前預測的低雙位數增幅。公司並將全年關稅成本預估，由原先的 22 億至 26 億美元下修至約 22 億美元，反映美國關稅下降，加上資料中心、基礎建設與能源專案支出持續擴張，進一步改善公司營運前景。
paras_en: Caterpillar, dubbed the 'economic canary,' reported second-quarter earnings that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven by the construction of artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, which boosted demand for power generation equipment and engineering machinery. The company's revenue and profit both surpassed expectations, with quarterly revenue exceeding $20 billion for the first time.
Caterpillar's (CAT-US) stock price rose 10.48% before the market opened on Tuesday, trading at $917 per share.

Caterpillar's second-quarter revenue grew 24% to $20.54 billion, surpassing market expectations of around $19.3 billion. Net income increased to $3.59 billion from $2.18 billion in the same period last year, with earnings per share rising to $7.77 from $4.62. Adjusted earnings per share reached $8.17, exceeding analysts' estimates of $6.17 to $6.22 and surpassing last year's $4.72.

CEO Joe Creed stated that this is the company's first time exceeding $20 billion in quarterly revenue, with strong order intake and increasing backlog orders demonstrating the expansion of its three core businesses.

As the US accelerates the construction of AI data centers, demand for construction equipment, diesel generators, and industrial gas turbines has increased significantly. Caterpillar's second-quarter new orders reached $9.4 billion, pushing its backlog to a record $72.1 billion.

The construction business saw revenue growth of 35% to $8.35 billion, with the North American market increasing by 50%. The energy and transportation business saw revenue growth of 17% to $8.24 billion, driven by the demand for large power generation sets and turbines for data centers.
The two business segments combined account for approximately 81% of the company's total revenue. The resource business saw revenue growth of 20% to $4.65 billion.

The energy and transportation segment has surpassed Caterpillar's most well-known construction equipment business, becoming the company's largest and fastest-growing business. Investors have therefore included Caterpillar in the AI concept stock category alongside Vertiv, GE Vernova, and other power equipment companies.

Looking ahead to the full year, Caterpillar expects revenue to grow by 15% to 19%, surpassing its previous prediction of low double-digit growth. The company has also lowered its full-year tariff cost estimate from $2.2 billion to $2.6 billion to around $2.2 billion, reflecting the decline in US tariffs and the continued expansion of data center, infrastructure, and energy project spending, which further improves the company's operating outlook.

items.title: 美伊協議傳接近達成、企業財報報喜！道瓊期貨勁揚600點
items.title_en: US-Iran Deal Nears Completion, Boosting Earnings Reports! Dow Futures Surge 600 Points
paras: 美股主要指數期貨周二 (4 日) 走高，開拓重工 (Caterpillar)(CAT-US) 與 Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US)財報優於預期，加上美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 透露，美國與伊朗可能很快就重新開放荷姆茲海峽達成協議，帶動國際油價重挫，道瓊期貨一度大漲 600 點。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數期貨上漲 600 點或 1.1%，主要受到開拓重工盤前大漲 9% 帶動；標普 500 指數期貨上漲 0.3%，那斯達克 100 指數期貨勁揚 1.1%。Palantir 財報報喜，激勵股價盤前飆升逾 15%，美光 (MU-US) 上漲 4%，邁威爾科技 (MRVL-US) 勁揚 8%。
貝森特接受《CNBC》節目「Squawk Box」訪問時表示，美方正在與伊朗談判，雙方可能在周二或周三達成協議，重新開放荷姆茲海峽、恢復商船自由通行，並推動衝突回歸較為正常的局面。
相關說法緩解市場對原油供應中斷的擔憂，西德州中級原油期貨下跌 4%，來到每桶約 77 美元；國際基準布蘭特原油期貨下挫 3%，報每桶約 80 美元。
美股周一已全面走強，道瓊指數收盤創下歷史新高。亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 市值首度突破 3 兆美元，輝達 (NVDA-US)、Meta(META-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 與微軟 (MSFT-US) 同步上漲。經過周一漲勢後，標普 500 指數距離盤中歷史高點僅差 0.27%，周二有望進一步刷新紀錄。
企業財報方面，開拓重工第二季營收與獲利雙雙超越預期，並上調全年營收成長展望，同時預估關稅成本將落在原先預測區間低端。Palantir 第二季業績同樣大幅優於預期，執行長 Alex Karp 更以「超凡脫俗」形容財報表現，商業部門營收激增 149% 至 7.64 億美元。
Interactive Brokers 資深經濟學家 Jose Torres 表示，製造業與服務業最新數據，加上近期企業財報電話會議，提振市場對企業回饋股東能力的信心，尤其科技股經歷大幅拋售後，估值已明顯降低。
投資人周二也將關注 6 月工廠訂單與國際貿易數據，以及 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 上市後首份季度財報。SpaceX 股價在開盤前上漲 2%。
paras_en: US stock market futures rose sharply on Tuesday (4th) as Caterpillar (CAT-US) and Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US) reported better-than-expected earnings, and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent revealed that the US and Iran may soon reach a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, leading to a sharp decline in international oil prices, with Dow futures surging 600 points.

As of the cut-off time, Dow Industrial Index futures rose 600 points or 1.1%, mainly driven by Caterpillar's pre-market surge of 9%; S&P 500 Index futures rose 0.3%, and Nasdaq 100 Index futures surged 1.1%. Palantir's earnings report was a pleasant surprise, driving its stock price to soar over 15% pre-market; Micron (MU-US) rose 4%, and Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) surged 8%.

Bessent, in an interview with CNBC's 'Squawk Box', stated that the US is in talks with Iran, and the two sides may reach a deal by Tuesday or Wednesday to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, restore commercial shipping freedom, and push the conflict back to a more normal state.

The related statement eased market concerns about oil supply disruptions, with West Texas Intermediate crude futures falling 4% to around $77 per barrel; International benchmark Brent crude futures dropped 3% to around $80 per barrel.

The US stock market had a strong rally on Monday, with the Dow Index closing at a new historical high. Amazon (AMZN-US) broke through the $3 trillion valuation mark for the first time, while NVIDIA (NVDA-US), Meta (META-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US), and Microsoft (MSFT-US) all rose in sync. Following Monday's surge, the S&P 500 Index is just 0.27% away from its intraday historical high, and is expected to break the record on Tuesday.

In terms of corporate earnings, Caterpillar reported second-quarter revenue and profit that exceeded expectations, and raised its full-year revenue growth outlook, while also estimating that tariff costs will fall within the previously predicted range. Palantir's second-quarter results were also significantly better than expected, with CEO Alex Karp describing the earnings report as 'exceptional', with commercial segment revenue surging 149% to $764 million.

Interactive Brokers' senior economist Jose Torres stated that the latest manufacturing and service industry data, combined with recent corporate earnings conference calls, have boosted market confidence in companies' ability to return value to shareholders, particularly in the tech sector, which has experienced significant selling pressure and has seen its valuation decline significantly.

Investors will also focus on June factory orders and international trade data on Tuesday, as well as SpaceX's (SPCX-US) first quarterly earnings report after its IPO. SpaceX's stock price rose 2% pre-market.

items.title: 2027年DRAM仍供不應求 輝達下調Rubin Ultra HBM配置
items.title_en: DRAM Still Short of Supply Through 2027; Nvidia Lowers Rubin Ultra HBM Configuration
paras: TrendForce 最新記憶體產業研究，由於 DRAM 供不應求格局將延續至 2027 年，且原廠 HBM4e 的驗證進度存在變數，自今年第三季起，輝達 (NVDA-US) 對 Rubin Ultra 的 HBM 配置已從 HBM4e 12hi，改為並行評估 HBM4e 8hi、HBM4 12hi、HBM4 8hi 等多項設計，目前尚未定案。除了輝達外，部分雲端服務供應商 (CSP) 也正考慮調降下一代自研 ASIC 的 HBM 容量設計。
TrendForce 表示，近期記憶體供給緊缺已導致數次 AI 晶片的 DRAM 規格調降。2026 上半年以來，CSP、伺服器 OEM 陸續下調 RDIMM 容量；日前輝達也考量 LPDDR5X 短缺將持續至 2027 年，決定將次世代 Vera Rubin Superchip 模組所搭載的 SOCAMM 容量減半。
針對 Rubin Ultra，輝達在 2025 年至 2026 上半年間皆以 HBM4e 12hi 作為基準設計，直至第三季上旬起開放評估其他較低的規格，目前持續研議中。此舉主要為應對供給端的兩項瓶頸。
首先，2027 年整體 DRAM 供應維持緊缺，將限制原廠可分配給 HBM 的晶圓產能。其次，HBM4e 12hi 的驗證、量產良率提升進程仍存在不確定性。
TrendForce 指出，輝達於 Rubin Ultra 世代的主要目標為 I/O speed 的提升，而次要目標為追求 GPU 出貨規模成長。若最終決定調降 HBM 規格，預期將傾向從調整堆疊層數 (DRAM stack layers) 著手。
總結而言，HBM4e 能否如期完成驗證與量產，將決定 Rubin Ultra 的 I/O speed 可否從前一代 Rubin 的 8 至 11.7Gbps 升級至 14 至 16Gbps，抑或僅能藉 HBM4 設計優化改善至 11 至 12Gbps。另一方面，在既定世代下，堆疊層數將決定單顆 GPU 的 HBM 搭載容量與可出貨 GPU 顆數之間的分配權衡。

TrendForce 認為，後續規格定案亦將取決於原廠晶圓供給分配。就供需而言，預估 2027 年 HBM 出貨位元將年增 50-60%，仍不足以支應需求端的成長。在供不應求格局的情況下，TrendForce 預期 2027 年 HBM 議價權仍偏向供應商，HBM 單位價格大幅上漲已成為產業共識。AI 晶片廠商將面臨 HBM 供給量緊縮與採購成本提高的雙重壓力，採用較低容量 HBM 的動機隨之增強。
paras_en: TrendForce’s latest memory industry research indicates that the DRAM shortage will persist through 2027, and the verification progress of manufacturers’ HBM4e remains uncertain. Starting in Q3 of this year, Nvidia (NVDA-US) has changed the HBM configuration for Rubin Ultra from HBM4e 12‑hi to a parallel evaluation of several designs, including HBM4e 8‑hi, HBM4 12‑hi and HBM4 8‑hi, none of which have been finalized yet. In addition to Nvidia, some cloud service providers (CSPs) are also considering reducing the HBM capacity design for their next‑generation in‑house ASICs.

In recent weeks, the tight memory supply has already forced several AI chips to downgrade their DRAM specifications. Since the first half of 2026, CSPs and server OEMs have been gradually lowering RDIMM capacities; Nvidia, noting that LPDDR5X shortages will continue into 2027, has decided to halve the SOCAMM capacity used in the next‑generation Vera Rubin Superchip module.

For Rubin Ultra, Nvidia used HBM4e 12‑hi as the baseline design throughout 2025 and the first half of 2026. Beginning in early Q3, the company opened an evaluation of lower‑spec options and is still studying the matter. The move is intended to address two supply‑side bottlenecks.

First, overall DRAM supply will remain tight in 2027, limiting the wafer capacity that manufacturers can allocate to HBM. Second, the verification and yield‑improvement timeline for HBM4e 12‑hi remains uncertain.

TrendForce notes that the primary goal for the Rubin Ultra generation is to boost I/O speed, while the secondary goal is to drive GPU shipment growth. If the HBM specification is ultimately lowered, the adjustment is expected to start with the number of stack layers (DRAM stack layers).

In summary, whether HBM4e can complete verification and mass production on schedule will determine if Rubin Ultra’s I/O speed can be upgraded from the previous Rubin’s 8‑11.7 Gbps to 14‑16 Gbps, or only improve to 11‑12 Gbps through HBM4 design optimizations. Meanwhile, within the defined generation, the stack layer count will dictate the trade‑off between HBM capacity per GPU and the number of GPUs that can be shipped.

TrendForce believes that the final specification will also depend on how manufacturers allocate wafer supply. From a supply‑demand perspective, HBM shipments are projected to grow 50‑60% year‑over‑year in 2027, still insufficient to meet demand growth. In a shortage environment, TrendForce expects HBM pricing power to remain with suppliers in 2027, and a sharp rise in HBM unit prices has become industry consensus. AI chip makers will face dual pressure from tighter HBM supply and higher procurement costs, increasing the incentive to adopt lower‑capacity HBM.

items.title: 美銀點名買入這「9檔」AI半導體股！最高潛在漲幅88%、雲端資本支出上看1.2兆美元
items.title_en: Bank of America Names 9 AI Semiconductor Stocks with Up to 88% Upside, Cloud Capital Spending to Reach $1.2 Trillion
paras: 儘管七月半導體類股遭遇賣壓，市場擔憂大型科技業者放緩人工智慧（AI）支出腳步會衝擊股市，但最新數據顯示，情勢正朝反方向發展。為此美銀也點名九支半導體股，認為其 12 個月目標價位有約 30 到 90％的上漲空間，並給予它們「買入」評級。
根據《TradingView》報導，科技巨頭的資本支出似乎沒有放緩的跡象。美國銀行 (BAC-US) 半導體分析師 Vivek Arya 就指出，未來十二個月，主要雲端服務業者的資本支出總額可望突破 1.2 兆美元。
今年夏天早些時候，市場預計美國五大超大規模資料中心營運商在 2026 年的支出約為 7,000 億美元。
Arya 於週一（3 日）表示：「雲端業者的投資意願依然強勁」，顯示 AI 基礎建設熱潮不僅持續時間超乎預期，投入資金規模也持續加碼。

科技巨頭燒錢，晶片供應商卻受惠

報導指出，AI 經濟體系內部正出現一種特殊的資源重分配現象。對雲端業者而言，基礎建設競賽成本節節攀升；但對供應鏈上游廠商來說，這些支出正是營收來源。
以微軟 (MSFT-US) 為例，其資本支出年增率一度高達 63%，自由現金流卻同期下滑 10%，資本支出佔營運現金流比重更逼近 100%，成為投資人質疑 AI 建設經濟效益的主因。
然而，站在天秤另一端的晶片供應商卻穩收其利。分析稱，雲端業者每多投入一美元建設 AI 資料中心，就代表對 GPU、客製化加速晶片、記憶體、網路設備與晶圓製造產能的需求隨之增加。
華爾街其他機構的預測也得出相同結論。摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 近日預估，超大規模雲端服務商的資本支出將在 2026 年達約 8,000 億美元，2027 年進一步攀升至 1.2 兆美元，遠高於該行一年前預估的約 4,500 億美元。
換言之，市場瓶頸正從「需求不足」轉為「供給跟不上」，這項轉變意義重大，若雲端業者支出持續走高，近期的半導體股修正就不再是 AI 循環告終的訊號，而更像是這波投資熱潮中的一次估值重整。

九檔潛在漲幅近 30％的半導體股

有鑑於此，美銀將受惠標的分為運算、記憶體、半導體設備、電源半導體及光學元件五大類別。
根據美銀最新目標價，以下九檔個股（依 8 月 3 日收盤價計算）有約 30 到 90％的潛在漲幅：

邁威爾科技 (MRVL-US) ：目標價 365 美元，潛在漲幅 88%
 美光科技 (MU-US) ：目標價 1550 美元，潛在漲幅 87%
 英特爾 (INTC-US) ：目標價 160 美元，潛在漲幅 76%
 輝達 (NVDA-US) ：目標價 350 美元，潛在漲幅 69%
Credo Technology (CRDO-US) ：目標價 340 美元，潛在漲幅 56%
 科磊 (KLAC-US) ：目標價 260 美元，潛在漲幅 42%
 應用材料 (AMAT-US) ：目標價 720 美元，潛在漲幅 39%
 博通 (AVGO-US) ：目標價 530 美元，潛在漲幅 35%
 超微半導體 (AMD-US) ：目標價 620 美元，潛在漲幅 28%


值得注意的是，這份名單橫跨 AI 基礎建設供應鏈的各個關鍵環節。
輝達與超微半導體提供加速運算晶片；博通與邁威爾科技則同時涉足客製化晶片與網路連結領域；Credo 專攻連結技術；美光供應維持運算晶片運作所需的記憶體；科磊與應用材料則位處更上游，銷售用於製造高複雜度晶片的設備。
這種廣泛的產業覆蓋面意義重大，代表這波投資邏輯已不再仰賴單一晶片廠商獨佔 AI 商機，而是取決於建構 AI 基礎建設本身所涉及的實體複雜度。

「供不應求」正成為新投資主軸

分析稱，記憶體市場堪稱最鮮明的案例。美光股價今年已因 AI 需求與供給緊縮相互激盪而大幅重新評價，記憶體循環也成為今年半導體類股中最強勁的交易題材之一。
連結技術領域也出現類似走勢。根據美銀先前研究，Credo 在主動式電纜市場的市佔率高達約 75%，該市場規模預估將由今年約 12 億美元，成長至 2030 年逾 70 億美元。
類似機制亦不斷在 AI 供應鏈中重演。雲端業者對運算力的渴求，速度總是超越供應商所能提供的產能，而這種「供不應求」的效應正持續擴散：

加速晶片需求增加，連帶推升記憶體需求；
伺服器數量增加，帶動更快速網路設備需求；
晶片複雜度提升，也需要更多晶圓製造與測試設備支援。


甚至運算密度的提升，也正在電力與散熱基礎建設領域創造出「次級商機」，例如液冷技術的轉型浪潮，已為資料中心散熱供應鏈帶來更龐大的訂單量。
因此，1.2 兆美元這個數字的意義，與其說是一項預測，不如說是當前 AI 投資循環所處階段的具體證據。
近期半導體股修正期間，市場多半聚焦於「科技巨頭是否已經燒錢過頭」的疑慮；但美國銀行最新的預估數據顯示，投資人或許很快就得面對截然相反的課題，即雲端業者的建設速度終究可能仍追不上需求。
paras_en: Despite the sell-off in semiconductor stocks in July, with the market worried that big tech companies would slow down their artificial intelligence (AI) spending, the latest data shows that the situation is moving in the opposite direction. As a result, Bank of America has named nine semiconductor stocks that it believes have a 30-90% upside potential over the next 12 months, giving them a 'buy' rating.

According to a report by TradingView, the capital spending of tech giants shows no signs of slowing down. Vivek Arya, a semiconductor analyst at Bank of America, pointed out that the total capital spending of major cloud service providers is expected to exceed $1.2 trillion over the next 12 months.

Earlier in the summer, the market had expected the top five hyperscale data center operators in the US to spend around $700 billion in 2026. However, Arya stated on Monday that 'the willingness to invest in cloud services remains strong', indicating that the AI infrastructure boom is not only lasting longer than expected but also increasing in scale.

The report notes that a special phenomenon of resource reallocation is occurring within the AI economy. For cloud service providers, the cost of infrastructure competition is rising, but for upstream manufacturers in the supply chain, these expenditures are a source of revenue.

Taking Microsoft (MSFT-US) as an example, its capital spending growth rate once reached 63%, while its free cash flow fell by 10% over the same period, and the proportion of capital spending to operating cash flow approached 100%, becoming a major reason for investors to question the economic benefits of AI construction.

However, chip suppliers are benefiting from this trend. Analysts say that for every dollar that cloud service providers invest in building AI data centers, the demand for GPUs, customized acceleration chips, memory, network equipment, and wafer manufacturing capacity increases.

Other institutions on Wall Street have also come to the same conclusion. Morgan Stanley (MS-US) recently estimated that the capital spending of hyperscale cloud service providers will reach around $800 billion in 2026 and further increase to $1.2 trillion in 2027, far exceeding the bank's estimate of around $450 billion a year ago.

In other words, the market bottleneck is shifting from 'lack of demand' to 'inadequate supply', a change that is significant. If cloud service providers' spending continues to rise, the recent correction in semiconductor stocks may not be a sign of the end of the AI cycle, but rather a revaluation in the midst of this investment boom.

Bank of America has identified nine semiconductor stocks with potential upside of nearly 30%. The bank categorizes the beneficiaries into five categories: computing, memory, semiconductor equipment, power semiconductors, and optical components.

According to Bank of America's latest target prices, the following nine stocks (based on the closing price on August 3) have a potential upside of 30-90%: Marvell Technology (MRVL-US), Micron Technology (MU-US), Intel (INTC-US), NVIDIA (NVDA-US), Credo Technology (CRDO-US), KLA-Tencor (KLAC-US), Applied Materials (AMAT-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US), and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US).

It's worth noting that this list spans various key segments of the AI infrastructure supply chain. NVIDIA and AMD provide acceleration computing chips; Broadcom and Marvell Technology are involved in customized chips and network connections; Credo specializes in connection technology; Micron supplies memory needed to operate computing chips; and KLA-Tencor and Applied Materials sell equipment used to manufacture high-complexity chips.

This broad industry coverage is significant, representing a shift in investment logic from relying on a single chip manufacturer to dominate AI opportunities to depending on the physical complexity involved in building AI infrastructure.

The 'supply shortage' is becoming a new investment theme. Analysts say that the memory market is a prime example. Micron's stock price has been revalued this year due to AI demand and supply tightness, and the memory cycle has become one of the strongest trading themes in semiconductor stocks.

A similar trend is emerging in the field of connection technology. According to Bank of America's previous research, Credo has a market share of around 75% in the active cable market, which is expected to grow from around $1.2 billion this year to over $7 billion by 2030.

A similar mechanism is being repeated in the AI supply chain. Cloud service providers' demand for computing power always exceeds the supply that manufacturers can provide, and this 'supply shortage' effect is spreading: the increased demand for acceleration chips drives up memory demand; the increase in server numbers drives up demand for faster network equipment; and the increase in chip complexity requires more wafer manufacturing and testing equipment.

Even the increase in computing density is creating 'secondary business opportunities' in the fields of power and cooling infrastructure, such as the wave of liquid cooling technology, which has brought a large number of orders to the data center cooling supply chain.
Therefore, the figure of $1.2 trillion is not just a prediction, but concrete evidence of the current stage of the AI investment cycle.

During the recent correction in semiconductor stocks, the market has been focused on concerns that tech giants may have overspent on AI; but Bank of America's latest estimate suggests that investors may soon face the opposite problem, namely that cloud service providers' construction speed may ultimately still not keep up with demand.

items.title: 股價較高點回跌逾4成！SpaceX首份財報將掀牌 AI、星鏈、星艦受檢驗
items.title_en: Stock Falls Over 40% From Recent Highs! SpaceX's First Earnings Report to Spotlight AI, Starlink, Starship Scrutiny
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)將於美東時間周二(4日)盤後公布2026會計年度第2季財報，市場預料結果可能引發股價劇烈波動，目前以人工智慧(AI)業務營收、虧損與資本支出這三大數字最受關注。
這家由全球首富馬斯克領軍的公司，目前市值約1.4兆美元，數周前一度高達3兆美元，目前股價仍為2026年預估營收的35倍，使本次財報成為市場焦點。
Cantor Fitzgerald分析師Colin Canfield表示，目前市場預估值分歧極大，「幾乎沒有人真正知道會開出什麼數字」，財報結果可能與市場預期出現相當大的落差。
AI財務數字與展望
SpaceX目前將業務劃分為三大部門，包括：太空(火箭發射與星艦計畫)，連網(星鏈衛星網路)，AI(主要為今年2月併入的xAI業務)。
三者當中，以AI業務最受市場關注，其在2026年第1季營收為8.18億美元，但營業虧損高達25億美元，單季資本支出更達77億美元。
市場將聚焦三項關鍵指標：AI營收是否快速成長，虧損是否收斂，
AI資本支出是否持續擴大。
SpaceX已與Anthropic及Google(GOOGL-US)簽署AI資料中心租賃協議。兩者當中，Google合約尚未開始貢獻營收，Anthropic每月約12.5億美元的租賃合約，則於5、6月逐步放量，但實際認列營收及獲利率仍不明朗。
投資人也將關注SpaceX對今年下半年及2027年AI業務展望，以及利用星鑑部署低成本AI運算衛星的測試時程。
星艦進度、星鏈用戶
星鑑(Starship)於7月完成第13次飛行測試，市場將關注：第14次測試何時進行，以及星鑑的研發支出規模。
SpaceX在第1季的太空事業新增廠房與設備支出約11億美元。
太空部門2025年營收41億美元，營業虧損為6.57億美元。而獵鷹九號(Falcon 9)在第2季的火箭發射約36次，多數為星鏈(Starlink)任務，因此不會認列為太空部門收入，市場預料投資人仍將把焦點放在AI及星鏈，而非火箭發射業務。
星鏈方面，截至第1季季末的全球訂戶已達1030萬戶，較一年前約500萬戶倍增。該項業務在2025年的營收為114億美元，營業利益44億美元。
市場將關注星鏈的訂戶成長速度、每位用戶平均收入(ARPU)，以及
企業及政府客戶訂單。Canfield預期，SpaceX將首度揭露更多有關星鏈的營運指標。
Canfield預期，這份財報將優於市場預期，且全年獲利展望可望上修。
目前華爾街平均預估第2季營收將為69億美元，而稅息折舊及攤銷前利益(EBITDA)為21億美元
全年部分，營收估為390億美元，EBITDA為173億美元。不過市場預估分歧極大。
解禁賣壓仍是股價隱憂
SapceX周一盤中一度跌至每股104.83美元、創上市新低，但終場反彈5.68%，收在每股114.53美元。然而周一收盤價仍比6月16日首次公開發行(IPO)後創下的歷史收盤高點(201.80美元)回跌了43%。
其中一項憂慮來自IPO禁售期即將屆滿。根據規劃，8月6日將有約9.12億股解禁，約一周後另有3.19億股解禁。
市場擔心早期投資人可能趁機獲利了結，對股價形成賣壓。但也有分析認為，市場通常會提前反映已知消息，因此真正解禁後未必再出現新一波拋售。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) will release its fiscal 2026 Q2 earnings after market close on Tuesday (the 4th) Eastern Time. The market expects the results could trigger sharp stock volatility, with AI revenue, losses, and capital expenditures being the three most watched figures.

Led by the world’s richest man Elon Musk, the company now has a market value of about $1.4 trillion, after briefly reaching $3 trillion a few weeks ago. Its share price still trades at roughly 35 times the projected 2026 revenue, making this earnings release a focal point for investors.
